text:
You had a productive day, moving your desk setup into the spare room and tackling various tasks related to it. I helped you create a checklist for the move, which I saved as a note called "Desk Move" with all the essential details.

You also received guidance on setting up your monitor for comfortable viewing, and we clarified your afternoon schedule, giving you some free time in the morning to set up your new workspace.

I set reminders for you to order cable ties or velcro straps tonight at 7:00 PM and to put out the old desk chair for the bulk pickup tomorrow morning. Unfortunately, my search for information on recycling old cables and a broken monitor in Canberra didn't yield any specific results.

A small win today was that the desk fit through the door without needing its legs removed, saving you some time.
